movelist.name: Amnesia
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Special Defense 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Encore
movelist.effect: Roll 1d6. On a result of 1 or 2, the target becomes Confused; on a result of 3 or 4 the target becomes Suppressed; on a result of 5 or 6 the target becomes Enraged.

movelist.name: Poison Gas
movelist.effect: Poison Gas Poisons all Legal Targets.

movelist.name: Acid Spray
movelist.effect: Acid Spray lowers the target’s Special Defense 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Yawn
movelist.effect: The target falls Asleep at the end of their next turn. Yawn cannot miss.

abilities.name: Liquid Ooze
abilities.effect: This user resists Poison-Type Damage one step further. Additionally, when this user is damaged by Absorb, Drain Punch, Giga Drain, Horn Leech, Leech Life, or Mega Drain, that Move gains Recoil ½ and the Move’s user does not gain any HP. If the user is hit by Leech Seed, the user does not lose Hit Points from Leech Seed; instead Leech Seed’s user loses Hit Points equal to this user’s Tick Value.

abilities.name: Limber
abilities.effect: The user is immune to Paralysis. Defensive.
